description: This file implements a class 'cConfig' that manages container configuration to generate 'lxc.conf' files, handling aspects like network, filesystem mounts, environment variables, capabilities, seccomp, LD_PRELOAD, root filesystem setup, and integration with other system components.

classes.name: cConfig
classes.description: Class representing container configuration that generates and manages lxc.conf configurations, including filesystem, network, environment, capabilities, seccomp, and LD_PRELOAD settings.

methods.name: __init__(self, sanityCheck, rootfs, privileged, crashReporting, append, prevUserName, prevGroupName, swapEnabled, capsGenerationEnabled)
methods.description: Initializes the cConfig instance with various container parameters, including sanity check, root filesystem, privileges, crash reporting, append mode, previous user/group, swap and caps generation flags.

methods.name: processUsersAndGroups(self, lxcParamsNode, lxcConfigNode, allUserNames, allGroupNames)
methods.description: Processes user and group settings from lxcConfigNode and lxcParamsNode, adding entries for container's /etc/passwd and /etc/group.

methods.name: createEnvConf(self, lxcConfigNode)
methods.description: Generates environment variable configuration entries, handling LD_PRELOAD dependencies.

methods.name: getSuffixLen(self, lib, preloadLib)
methods.description: Computes the suffix length match between a library path and a preload library name.

methods.name: createLdSoPreloadConf(self, lxcConfigNode)
methods.description: Creates configuration for ld.so.preload, including production of preload library paths and handling crash reporting libraries.

methods.name: createNetworkConf(self, lxcConfigNode)
methods.description: Constructs network configuration entries for different network types and manages auto-installed libraries.

methods.name: addRequiredLibs(self, source, addSourceItself = False, indent = "")
methods.description: Adds dependencies libraries required by a specified library, following ELF dependencies, creating symlinks if needed.

methods.name: scanDir(self, path)
methods.description: Recursively scans directories to add library dependencies.

methods.name: createMountPoint(self, type, path, source)
methods.description: Creates filesystem mount points of type 'dir', 'file', or 'dev'.

methods.name: getAutodevSettings(self, lxcConfigNode)
methods.description: Generates configuration for autodev based on lxcConfigNode.

methods.name: sortMountOptions(self, mountOptions)
methods.description: Reorders mount options to match default preferences.

methods.name: addMountPointIfMissing(self, mountPointNode, _type, source, destination, options)
methods.description: Ensures a mount point entry exists with specified source, destination, and options.

methods.name: preprocessMountPoints(self, mountPointNode)
methods.description: Ensures nsswitch.conf is bind-mounted.

methods.name: getAutodevHookSettings(self, lxcConfigNode)
methods.description: Configures autodev hook script based on lxcConfigNode.

methods.name: generateMountPoints(self, mountPointNode)
methods.description: Generates and configures filesystem mount points from mountPointNode, including nested ranges.

methods.name: moveContent(self, moveContentNode)
methods.description: Moves content from source to destination as specified in moveContentNode.

methods.name: processLibBinding(self, libname)
methods.description: Processes library dependencies, adding required libs and handling symlinks.

methods.name: generateLibMountPoints(self, libBindingsNode)
methods.description: Generates mount binds for library dependencies, based on libBindingsNode.

methods.name: generateHardlinks(self, libHardlinksNode)
methods.description: Creates hard links for libraries specified in libHardlinksNode.

methods.name: generateDirsAndFiles(self, dirsAndFilesNode)
methods.description: Creates directories and files as specified in dirsAndFilesNode.

methods.name: generateSoftLinks(self, softLinksNode)
methods.description: Creates symbolic links specified in softLinksNode.

methods.name: updateLibScanDirsList(self, rootfsNode)
methods.description: Updates list of directories to scan for libraries based on rootfsNode.

methods.name: createRootfsConf(self, rootfsNode)
methods.description: Generates configuration for the container's root filesystem, including mounts, dependencies, and hard links.

methods.name: genereteUserSettings(self, lxcConfigNode)
methods.description: Creates user and group ID configuration if container is privileged.

methods.name: genereteConsoleSettings(self, lxcConfigNode)
methods.description: Configures TTY and PTY limits.

methods.name: generateCapsSettings(self, lxcConfigNode)
methods.description: Configures capability dropping/keeping.

methods.name: createSeccompConf(self, lxcConfigNode)
methods.description: Creates seccomp profile configuration.

methods.name: createLxcConf(self, lxcConfigNode)
methods.description: Main method to generate the complete lxc.conf, including appending other configurations, mounting, environment, security, network, capabilities, etc.
